description: Extend the typed API client (frontend/src/api.ts) with the three new admin routes (getAdminQuiz, updateQuiz, deleteQuiz) plus their types, mirroring createQuiz's auth + error-handling semantics exactly. These are the data-layer methods the reworked AdminPage will consume. Independent of the UI features but must land first because FEAT-002 depends on it.
steps: In frontend/src/api.ts, add new exported types mirroring the PR-a contract (base is API_BASE which already includes '/api'): (a) AdminQuestion { n: number; text: string; options: string[]; answerIndex: number } for the answerIndex-inclusive admin GET; (b) AdminQuizDetail { quizId: string; title: string; questions: AdminQuestion[] }; (c) UpdateQuizInput { title: string; questions: AdminQuestionInput[] } (reuse existing AdminQuestionInput { text, options, answerIndex }); (d) UpdateQuizResponse { quizId: string; title: string; questionCount: number }; (e) DeleteQuizResponse { quizId: string; deleted: boolean }.

Add a small shared helper that centralizes the createQuiz auth/error semantics so the three new methods do not duplicate the 401/403/JSON-message/non-JSON logic (e.g. an internal async function adminRequest<T>(path, method, idToken, body?) that: sets headers { authorization: 'Bearer ' + idToken } and, when a body is present, 'content-type': 'application/json'; on res.status===401 throws new AuthError(); on res.status===403 throws new Error('権限がありません'); reads JSON only when content-type includes application/json; on !res.ok throws Error preferring data.message else 'リクエストに失敗しました (' + res.status + ')'; on ok-but-non-JSON throws the existing UNEXPECTED_NON_JSON constant; returns data as T). Refactor createQuiz to use this helper OR leave createQuiz as-is and have the helper mirror it identically. Keep createQuiz's exact existing behavior and messages either way.

Add export async function getAdminQuiz(quizId: string, idToken: string): Promise<AdminQuizDetail> that does a GET to '/admin/quizzes/' + encodeURIComponent(quizId) with the bearer token, using the shared admin semantics (AuthError on 401, '権限がありません' on 403, JSON-message preference on other non-ok including 404, non-JSON guard). A 404 should surface as an Error whose message is the server's JSON message when present.

Add export async function updateQuiz(quizId: string, input: UpdateQuizInput, idToken: string): Promise<UpdateQuizResponse> that does a PUT to '/admin/quizzes/' + encodeURIComponent(quizId) with JSON body JSON.stringify(input) and the bearer token, using the shared admin semantics.

Add export async function deleteQuiz(quizId: string, idToken: string): Promise<DeleteQuizResponse> that does a DELETE to '/admin/quizzes/' + encodeURIComponent(quizId) with the bearer token (no body), using the shared admin semantics.

Do NOT change existing exports (getQuizzes, getQuiz, submitAnswers, createQuiz, existing types, AuthError, fetchJson, apiUrl, UNEXPECTED_NON_JSON) in a behavior-altering way. Keep the JP comments style consistent with the file.
acceptance_criteria: frontend/src/api.ts exports getAdminQuiz, updateQuiz, deleteQuiz and the new types AdminQuestion, AdminQuizDetail, UpdateQuizInput, UpdateQuizResponse, DeleteQuizResponse.
All three new methods send 'authorization: Bearer <idToken>'; PUT and POST send 'content-type: application/json'; DELETE and GET send no body.

All three throw AuthError on HTTP 401 and Error('権限がありません') on HTTP 403, prefer a JSON 'message' on other non-ok responses (including 404), and guard non-JSON responses using UNEXPECTED_NON_JSON, matching createQuiz.
createQuiz's existing observable behavior and messages are unchanged.
Paths are relative to API_BASE: '/admin/quizzes/{quizId}' with quizId encoded via encodeURIComponent.
verification: Read frontend/src/api.ts and confirm the three new functions and types compile against existing types (AdminQuestionInput, AuthError) with no type errors by inspection.
On the user's networked host: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build (tsc type-check must pass).
Confirm no changes were made to lambda/, lib/, test/, or amplify.yml.
findings: Implemented in frontend/src/api.ts only. Added exported types AdminQuestion, AdminQuizDetail, UpdateQuizInput, UpdateQuizResponse, DeleteQuizResponse (placed after CreateQuizResponse). Introduced internal helper adminRequest<T>(path, method, idToken, body?) that centralizes createQuiz's auth/error semantics: sets 'authorization: Bearer <idToken>' always; adds 'content-type: application/json' and JSON body only when body !== undefined; 401 -> AuthError; 403 -> Error('権限がありません'); reads JSON only when content-type includes application/json; !res.ok -> Error preferring data.message else 'リクエストに失敗しました (' + res.status + ')'; ok-but-non-JSON -> UNEXPECTED_NON_JSON. Refactored createQuiz to delegate to adminRequest (behavior/messages unchanged). Added getAdminQuiz (GET), updateQuiz (PUT with body), deleteQuiz (DELETE no body), all against '/admin/quizzes/' + encodeURIComponent(quizId). No changes to getQuizzes, getQuiz, submitAnswers, existing types, AuthError, fetchJson, apiUrl, UNEXPECTED_NON_JSON. Verification was read-based/correct-by-construction: sandbox is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY (npm registry 403), so npm install / tsc / vite build cannot run here. User must verify on networked host with: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build. Committed as d861eb5 on branch feat/admin-ui-polish. Did not touch lambda/, lib/, test/, amplify.yml, or generate a lockfile.
